case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your request for a lower price and extended payment terms of 60 days. Our initial calculation strictly reflects the verified increases in our material and labour costs, which are necessary to uphold our standard of craftsmanship. However, we deeply value our long relationship and the shared heritage of our region. To support our continued cooperation, we are willing to accept the 60-day payment terms, and we offer a revised price of €137.30 per unit. 

Thus, our current Angebot stands at a price of €137.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days. We take immense pride in the work our people produce for you, and we trust this step forward reflects our commitment to a successful future together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and appreciate the step towards our position. However, our initial calculation was based on verified cost increases that we cannot simply absorb while maintaining our standard of craftsmanship. 

In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we can make a further concession to €136.50 per unit. Our offer stands at a price of €136.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

It is always a pleasure working with your respected house, and we trust this proposal reflects both our deep relationship and the enduring quality of our foundry work.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and the movement towards our position. It is always a pleasure to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, a valued partner connected to our region and our family-run business for so many years. 

To reach an agreement, we are prepared to make a further concession to a price of €135.90 per unit. Our offer comes with a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We trust this demonstrates our commitment to our long-standing partnership and the quality of our foundry work, which our dedicated people take immense pride in every single day. 

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued movement and the respectful dialogue between our houses.

We trust this further step brings us to a mutually agreeable conclusion and allows us to continue the long-standing, valued cooperation between our traditions.
